## Video effects (36) - `python scripts/fx_pack.py NAME IN OUT [--at S:E] [--p k=v]`

| Effect | What it does | Params (defaults) |
|---|---|---|
| `beat-pulse` | zoom pulse on every beat of the music. p: bpm, amount | bpm=120, amount=0.045 |
| `blur-reveal` | starts blurred and snaps sharp (stepped). --at S:E is the reveal window | sigma=24 |
| `bw` | black & white with punchy contrast | - |
| `color-pop` | keep ONE colour, everything else goes black & white (hex like 0xFF0000) | color=0xFF3030, similarity=0.35, blend=0.12 |
| `duotone` | two-colour poster look. c1=shadow rgb, c2=highlight rgb (0-1 floats as r,g,b) | c1=0.05,0.02,0.25, c2=1.0,0.45,0.35 |
| `dutch-tilt` | rocking tilt / dutch angle | deg=3, hz=2.0 |
| `enhance` | denoise + normalise exposure + sharpen + tiny saturation lift (fix weak footage) | - |
| `fade-io` | fade from/to black (video + audio). p: fin, fout seconds | fin=0.4, fout=0.5 |
| `flash` | white flash that decays quickly (put on cuts and hits). --at is the flash START time | dur=0.35, power=0.9 |
| `freeze` | freeze-frame at --at T for p.dur seconds (mode=plain|desat|zoom). Adds dur to length | dur=1.0, mode=desat |
| `glitch` | digital glitch: slice displacement + RGB split bursts inside --at S:E | intensity=1.0, seed=3 |
| `glow` | soft bloom / dreamy highlight glow | sigma=28, strength=0.45 |
| `handheld` | gentle handheld camera drift for the whole clip (adds life to static shots) | amount=14 |
| `invert-flash` | anime impact frame: colours invert for a few frames (use short --at, e.g. 2.0:2.1) | - |
| `ken-burns` | turn a STILL IMAGE into a slow zoom/pan video. IN is the image. p: dur, direction=in|out|left|right|up, zoom, fit=contain|cover, bg=color | dur=5, direction=in, zoom=1.25, w=1080, h=1920, fit=contain, bg=0x111116 |
| `lens-distort` | fisheye bulge for a hit or reveal | k=0.35 |
| `letterbox` | cinematic black bars that slide in (and stay) | ratio=0.11, speed=0.6 |
| `light-leak` | warm animated light leak that fades in/out over --at S:E (film/cinematic transitions) | strength=0.7 |
| `mirror` | mirror the frame: lr (left copied right), tb, or quad | mode=lr |
| `old-film` | sepia + flicker + grain + vignette (vintage / flashback) | grain=14 |
| `pip` | picture-in-picture: 2nd input shrinks into a corner with border. p: pos=tr|tl|br|bl, scale, margin | pos=br, scale=0.38, margin=40, border=6 |
| `pixel-reveal` | mosaic that resolves into sharp (stepped). --at S:E is the window | block=96 |
| `progress-bar` | thin retention bar filling across the video (top/bottom). p: pos=top|bottom, color | pos=bottom, color=yellow, height=14 |
| `reverse` | play --at S:E backwards (rewind moment), rest unchanged | - |
| `rgb-split` | chromatic aberration: red/blue channels pull apart (hit, glitch, impact) | amount=14 |
| `scanlines` | CRT scanlines overlay | gap=4, opacity=0.2 |
| `sketch` | pencil-sketch outlines on white | - |
| `spin-in` | quick roll/spin settle at the start (intro punch). --at start time | turns=1.0, dur=0.6 |
| `split-screen` | stack two videos vertically (reaction / before-after / comparison). IN, IN2 | - |
| `stabilize` | two-pass shake removal for handheld footage (vidstab) | smoothing=12 |
| `strobe` | strobing flicker (EDM drops, shock) | hz=10, amount=0.2 |
| `stutter` | beat-repeat: loop a tiny slice p.n times at --at T (p.len seconds each). Adds time | len=0.18, n=4 |
| `tilt-shift` | miniature / depth-of-field look: sharp band, blurred top & bottom | sigma=14, band=0.5 |
| `toon` | cartoon look: posterised colours + ink outlines | levels=40 |
| `trail` | ghost trails on motion (echo / afterimage) | decay=0.93 |
| `vhs` | retro VHS: colour bleed, scanlines, noise, soft focus | noise=18 |

## Motion-graphic templates (29) - `python scripts/mg.py TEMPLATE OUT.mov --p k=v`

| Template | What it does | Params (defaults), duration |
|---|---|---|
| `lower-third` | name + title bar slides in, holds, slides out | name='IBRAHIM', title='FOUNDER', color='FFD933', y=0.74; 4.0s |
| `title-card` | kinetic title: words fly in alternately with overshoot, underline sweeps | text='BUILT TO ROAR', color='FFD933', y=0.45, size=170; 3.5s |
| `typewriter` | quote typed out with cursor, then author line | text='Make it simple, but significant.', author='DON DRAPER', color='FFD933', size=70; 4.0s |
| `kinetic-words` | sentence appears word by word with rotation/scale pops, hero word highlighted | text='SLOW DOWN TO SPEED UP', hero=3, color='FFD933', size=140; 4.0s |
| `glitch-title` | title with RGB split + slice jitter bursts, then settles | text='SYSTEM FAILURE', color='00F0FF', size=130; 3.0s |
| `neon-text` | neon sign text with glow and flicker | text='OPEN 24/7', color='FF2FA0', size=150; 3.5s |
| `highlight-box` | marker highlight sweeps behind a text line (emphasis) | text='THIS IS THE KEY', color='FFD933', size=100; 3.0s |
| `split-reveal` | text revealed by two halves sliding apart | text='THE REVEAL', color='FFD933', size=160; 3.0s |
| `step-number` | big step number + title wipe (01 / 02 / 03 explainers) | number='01', text='PLAN YOUR HOOK', color='FFD933'; 3.0s |
| `social-handle` | @handle card: avatar circle, verified tick, slide in/out | handle='@your.handle', sub='FOLLOW FOR MORE', color='FFD933'; 3.5s |
| `counter` | number counts up with pop at the end (stats, results) | to=1000, start=0, prefix='', suffix='+', label='FOLLOWERS', color='FFD933', size=260; 3.0s |
| `progress-ring` | circular ring fills to a percentage with number in the centre | percent=75, label='COMPLETE', color='FFD933'; 3.0s |
| `bar-chart` | animated bar chart. values like 'JAN:30,FEB:55,MAR:90' | values='JAN:30,FEB:55,MAR:90,APR:70', color='FFD933', title='GROWTH'; 4.0s |
| `rating-stars` | stars fill one by one with pop (reviews) | stars=5, label='5.0 RATING', color='FFD933'; 3.0s |
| `checklist` | checklist: items type in, check marks draw. items 'A|B|C' | items='HOOK|VALUE|CTA', color='3DDC84', size=84; 4.5s |
| `sale-badge` | starburst price/discount badge that pops, rotates and pulses | text='50% OFF', sub='TODAY ONLY', color='FF3B30'; 3.0s |
| `countdown` | 3-2-1 countdown with ring sweep and pop per number | start=3, color='FFD933'; 3.5s |
| `callout-circle` | hand-drawn circle draws around a point (x,y,r as fractions) + optional label | x=0.5, y=0.45, r=0.2, color='FF3B30', label='LOOK HERE'; 3.0s |
| `arrow-pointer` | bold arrow bounces toward a point (x,y fractions, angle degrees) | x=0.5, y=0.55, angle=90, color='FFD933', size=230; 3.0s |
| `follow-button` | FOLLOW pill gets tapped by a cursor and turns into FOLLOWING + check | color='FFD933', text='FOLLOW', done='FOLLOWING'; 3.5s |
| `like-burst` | hearts float up and fade (like / love moment) | color='FF2D55', count=22; 3.0s |
| `confetti` | colourful confetti burst falling with spin (celebration) | count=160; 3.5s |
| `location-pin` | map pin drops with ripple + place name | text='DUBAI', color='FF3B30'; 3.5s |
| `speed-lines` | manga/anime radial speed lines (action, zoom, impact) | color='FFFFFF', density=90, inner=0.28; 2.0s |
| `news-ticker` | BREAKING news bar with scrolling text | label='BREAKING', text='YOUR HEADLINE SCROLLS ACROSS THE BOTTOM OF THE SCREEN  •  ', color='E50914'; 5.0s |
| `logo-reveal` | image/logo reveal: ring burst, bounce-in, light shine sweep | image='', width=700, color='FFD933'; 3.5s |
| `sticker-pop` | image pops in like a sticker with wobble, then floats (use PNG with transparency) | image='', width=760; 3.5s |
| `before-after` | before/after wipe with moving divider (needs before= and after= images) | before='', after='', color='FFD933'; 4.0s |
| `slideshow` | images (comma list) with Ken-Burns zoom and crossfades; full-frame video | images='', fade=0.4; 6.0s |
